1.77.m: Accompanied by the power Kṣemaṅkarī, crushing bands of thieves, / armed with arrows and a bow, may he protect the eastern direction for me.

1.77.s:
śrīkarīśaktisahito mārībhayavināśakaḥ /
śaracāpadharaḥ śrīmān diśaṃ me pātu dakṣiṇām //
1.77.d:
श्रीकरीशक्तिसहितो मारीभयविनाशकः ।
शरचापधरः श्रीमान् दिशं मे पातु दक्षिणाम् ॥
1.77.m: Accompanied by the power Śrīkarī, destroying fear of plagues, / bearing arrows and a bow, may the glorious one protect my southern direction.

1.77.s:
mahāvaśyakarīyuktaḥ sarvaśatruvināśakṛt /
maheṣucāpadhṛkpātu mama prācetasīṃ diśam //
1.77.d:
महावश्यकरीयुक्तः सर्वशत्रुविनाशकृत् ।
महेषुचापधृक्पातु मम प्राचेतसीं दिशम् ॥
1.77.m: Joined with [the power] Mahāvaśyakarī, destroying all enemies, / holding great arrows and a bow, may he protect my western direction.

1.77.s:
yaśaḥkaryā samāyukto daityasaṃghavināśanaḥ /
parirakṣatu me samyagvidiśaṃ caitrabhānavīm //
1.77.d:
यशःकर्या समायुक्तो दैत्यसंघविनाशनः ।
परिरक्षतु मे सम्यग्विदिशं चैत्रभानवीम् ॥
1.77.m: Accompanied by Yaśaḥkarī, destroying hordes of Daityas, / may he thoroughly protect my south-eastern intermediate direction.

1.77.s:
vidyākarīsamāyuktaḥ sumahahuḥkhanāśanaḥ /
pātu me nairṛtīṃ cāpapāṇirvidiśamīśvaraḥ //
1.77.d:
विद्याकरीसमायुक्तः सुमहहुःखनाशनः ।
पातु मे नैरृतीं चापपाणिर्विदिशमीश्वरः ॥
1.77.m: Accompanied by Vidyākarī, destroying very great sorrow, / may the Lord, with a bow in hand, protect my south-western intermediate direction.

1.77.s:
dhanakaryā samāyukto mahādurita nāśanaḥ /
iṣvāsaneṣudhṛkpātu vidiśaṃ mama vāyavīm //
1.77.d:
धनकर्या समायुक्तो महादुरित नाशनः ।
इष्वासनेषुधृक्पातु विदिशं मम वायवीम् ॥
1.77.m: Accompanied by Dhanakarī, destroying great sins, / holding a bow and arrows, may he protect my north-western intermediate direction.

1.77.s:
āyuḥkaryā yutaḥ śrīmānmahābhayavināśanaḥ /
cāpeṣudhārī śaivīṃ me vidiśaṃ parirakṣatu //
1.77.d:
आयुःकर्या युतः श्रीमान्महाभयविनाशनः ।
चापेषुधारी शैवीं मे विदिशं परिरक्षतु ॥
1.77.m: Accompanied by Āyuḥkarī, glorious, destroying great fears, / holding a bow and arrows, may he thoroughly protect my north-eastern intermediate direction.

1.77.s:
vijayaśrīyutaḥ sākṣātsahasrāradharo vibhuḥ /
diśamūrddhvāmavatu me sarvaduṣṭabhayaṅkaraḥ //
1.77.d:
विजयश्रीयुतः साक्षात्सहस्रारधरो विभुः ।
दिशमूर्द्ध्वामवतु मे सर्वदुष्टभयङ्करः ॥
1.77.m: Endowed with the goddess of victory, holding the thousand-spoked [discus] visibly, the all-pervading lord, / inspiring terror in all the wicked, may he protect my upper direction.

1.77.s:
śaṅkhabhṛtsumahāśaktisaṃyuto 'pyadharāṃ diśam /
parirakṣatu me duḥkhadhvāntasambhedabhāskaraḥ //
1.77.d:
शङ्खभृत्सुमहाशक्तिसंयुतो ऽप्यधरां दिशम् ।
परिरक्षतु मे दुःखध्वान्तसम्भेदभास्करः ॥
1.77.m: Bearing a conch, joined with very great power, / may the sun dispelling the darkness of sorrow protect my lower direction.

1.77.s:
mahāyogasamāyuktaḥ sarvadikcakramaṇḍalaḥ /
mahāyogīśvaraḥ pātu sarvato mama padmabhṛt //
1.77.d:
महायोगसमायुक्तः सर्वदिक्चक्रमण्डलः ।
महायोगीश्वरः पातु सर्वतो मम पद्मभृत् ॥
1.77.m: Endowed with great yoga, whose circle of wheels covers all directions, / may the lord of great yogins, holding a lotus, protect me on every side.

1.77.s:
etāstu mūrtayo raktā raktamālyāṃśukāvṛtāḥ /
pradhānadevatārūpāḥ pṛthagrathavare sthitāḥ //
1.77.d:
एतास्तु मूर्तयो रक्ता रक्तमाल्यांशुकावृताः ।
प्रधानदेवतारूपाः पृथग्रथवरे स्थिताः ॥
1.77.m: These forms are red, covered in red garlands and garments, / embodying the principal deity, standing separately on excellent chariots.

1.77.s:
śaktayaḥ padmahastāścata nīlendīvarasannnibhāḥ /
śuklamālyānuvasanāḥ suliptatilakojjvalāḥ //
1.77.d:
शक्तयः पद्महस्ताश्चत नीलेन्दीवरसन्न्निभाः ।
शुक्लमाल्यानुवसनाः सुलिप्ततिलकोज्ज्वलाः ॥
1.77.m: The powers hold lotuses in their hands, resembling blue water-lilies, / dressed in white garlands and garments, gleaming with well-anointed marks [on their foreheads].

1.77.s:
tatpārśadeśvarāḥ svasvavāhanāyudhabhūṣaṇāḥ /
svasvadikṣu sthitāḥ pāntu māmindrādyā mahābalāḥ //
1.77.d:
तत्पार्शदेश्वराः स्वस्ववाहनायुधभूषणाः ।
स्वस्वदिक्षु स्थिताः पान्तु मामिन्द्राद्या महाबलाः ॥
1.77.m: May the rulers of the directions beside him, with their respective mounts, weapons, and ornaments, / stationed in their own quarters, Indra and the rest of great might, protect me.

1.77.s:
etastasya samākhyātāḥ sarvāvaraṇadevatāḥ /
sarvato māṃ sadā pātuṃ sarvaśaktisamanvitāḥ //
1.77.d:
एतस्तस्य समाख्याताः सर्वावरणदेवताः ।
सर्वतो मां सदा पातुं सर्वशक्तिसमन्विताः ॥
1.77.m: These are proclaimed as all his encircling deities; / endowed with all powers, may they always protect me from every side.

1.77.s:
hṛdaye codare nābhau jaṭhare guhyamaṇḍale /
tejorūpāḥ sthitāḥ pātuṃ vāñchāsukhanadrumāḥ //
1.77.d:
हृदये चोदरे नाभौ जठरे गुह्यमण्डले ।
तेजोरूपाः स्थिताः पातुं वाञ्छासुखनद्रुमाः ॥
1.77.m: Stationed in the heart, belly, navel, stomach, and the secret region, / in the form of light, wish-fulfilling trees of desires and happiness, may they protect me.

1.77.s:
diśaṃ cānye mahāvarṇā mantrarūpā mahojjvalāḥ /
vyāpakatvena pāntvasmānāpādatalamastakam //
1.77.d:
दिशं चान्ये महावर्णा मन्त्ररूपा महोज्ज्वलाः ।
व्यापकत्वेन पान्त्वस्मानापादतलमस्तकम् ॥
1.77.m: And may the other great syllables of the directions, having the nature of mantras and very radiant, / protect us pervasively from the soles of our feet to our head.

1.77.s:
kārtavīryaḥ śiraḥ pātu lalāṭaṃ haihayeśvaraḥ /
sumukho me mukhaṃ pātu karṇauṃ vyāptajagattrayaḥ //
1.77.d:
कार्तवीर्यः शिरः पातु ललाटं हैहयेश्वरः ।
सुमुखो मे मुखं पातु कर्णौं व्याप्तजगत्त्रयः ॥
1.77.m: May Kārtavīrya protect my head; may the lord of the Haihayas protect my forehead; / may the pleasant-faced one protect my face; may he who pervades the three worlds protect my ears.

1.77.s:
sukumāro hanuṃ pātu bhrūyugaṃ me dhanurdharaḥ /
nayanaṃ puṃmaḍarīkākṣago nāsikāṃ me guṇākaraḥ //
1.77.d:
सुकुमारो हनुं पातु भ्रूयुगं मे धनुर्धरः ।
नयनं पुंमडरीकाक्षगो नासिकां मे गुणाकरः ॥
1.77.m: May the delicate one protect my chin; may the bowman protect my two eyebrows; / may the lotus-eyed one protect my eyes; may the treasury of virtues protect my nose.

1.77.s:
adharoṣṭhau sadā pātu brahjñeyo dvijānkaviḥ /
sarvaśāstrakalādhārī jihvāṃ cibukamavyayaḥ //
1.77.d:
अधरोष्ठौ सदा पातु ब्रह्ज्ञेयो द्विजान्कविः ।
सर्वशास्त्रकलाधारी जिह्वां चिबुकमव्ययः ॥
1.77.m: May the knower of Brahman always protect my lower lip; may the wise one protect my teeth; / may he who holds all scriptures and arts protect my tongue, and the imperishable one my chin.

1.77.s:
dattātreyapriyaḥ kaṇṭhaṃ skandhau rājakuleśvaraḥ /
bhujau daśāsyadarpaghno hṛdayaṃ me mahābalaḥ //
1.77.d:
दत्तात्रेयप्रियः कण्ठं स्कन्धौ राजकुलेश्वरः ।
भुजौ दशास्यदर्पघ्नो हृदयं मे महाबलः ॥
1.77.m: May the beloved of Dattātreya protect my throat; may the lord of the royal race protect my shoulders; / may the crusher of the ten-headed [Rāvaṇa's] pride protect my arms; may the very powerful one protect my heart.

1.77.s:
kukṣiṃ rakṣatu me vidvān vakṣaḥ parapurañjayaḥ /
karau sarvārthadaḥ pātukarāgrāṇi jagatpriyaḥ //
1.77.d:
कुक्षिं रक्षतु मे विद्वान् वक्षः परपुरञ्जयः ।
करौ सर्वार्थदः पातुकराग्राणि जगत्प्रियः ॥
1.77.m: May the learned one protect my belly; may the conqueror of enemy cities protect my chest; / may the bestower of all wealth protect my hands; may the beloved of the universe protect my fingertips.

1.77.s:
revāṃbagulīlāsaṃhapto jaṭharaṃ parirakṣatu /
vīraśūrastu me nābhiṃ pārśvau me sarvaduṣṭahā //
1.77.d:
रेवांबगुलीलासंहप्तो जठरं परिरक्षतु ।
वीरशूरस्तु मे नाभिं पार्श्वौ मे सर्वदुष्टहा ॥
1.77.m: May he who took delight in playing in the waters of the Revā protect my stomach; / may the brave hero protect my navel; may the slayer of all wicked beings protect my flanks.

1.77.s:
sahasrabhujanṛtpṛṣṭaṃ saptadvīpādhipaḥ kaṭim /
ūrū māhiṣmatīnātho jānunī vallabho bhuvaḥ //
1.77.d:
सहस्रभुजनृत्पृष्टं सप्तद्वीपाधिपः कटिम् ।
ऊरू माहिष्मतीनाथो जानुनी वल्लभो भुवः ॥
1.77.m: May the thousand-armed one protect my back; may the sovereign of the seven continents protect my waist; / may the lord of Māhiṣmatī protect my thighs; may the beloved of the earth protect my knees.

1.77.s:
jaṅghe vīrādhipaḥ pātu pātu pādau manojavaḥ /
pātu sarvāyudhadharaḥ sarvāṅgaṃ sarvamarmasu //
1.77.d:
जङ्घे वीराधिपः पातु पातु पादौ मनोजवः ।
पातु सर्वायुधधरः सर्वाङ्गं सर्वमर्मसु ॥
1.77.m: May the sovereign of heroes protect my shanks; may he who is swift as thought protect my feet; / may he who bears all weapons protect my whole body at every vital point.

1.77.s:
sarvaduṣṭāntakaḥ pātu dhātvaṣṭakakalevaram /
prāṇādidaśajīveśānsarvaśiṣṭeṣṭado 'vatu //
1.77.d:
सर्वदुष्टान्तकः पातु धात्वष्टककलेवरम् ।
प्राणादिदशजीवेशान्सर्वशिष्टेष्टदो ऽवतु ॥
1.77.m: May the ender of all the wicked protect my body of eight bodily elements; / may he who grants all that the righteous desire protect the ten vital airs and the rest, lords of life.

1.77.s:
vaśīkṛtendriyagrāmaḥ pātu sarvendriyāṇi me /
anuktamapi yatsthāna śarīrāntarbahiśca yat //
1.77.d:
वशीकृतेन्द्रियग्रामः पातु सर्वेन्द्रियाणि मे ।
अनुक्तमपि यत्स्थान शरीरान्तर्बहिश्च यत् ॥
1.77.m: May he who has subdued the host of senses protect all my sense organs; / whatever place has not been mentioned, whether inside the body or outside,

1.77.s:
tatsarvaṃ pātu me sarvalokanātheśvareśvaraḥ /
vajrātsārataraṃ cedaṃ śarīraṃ kavacāvṛtam //
1.77.d:
तत्सर्वं पातु मे सर्वलोकनाथेश्वरेश्वरः ।
वज्रात्सारतरं चेदं शरीरं कवचावृतम् ॥
1.77.m: may the Lord of the lords of all the worlds protect all that for me. / And covered by this armour, harder than a diamond,

1.77.s:
bādhāśatavinirmuktamastu me bhayavarjitam /
baddhedaṃ kavacaṃ divyamabhedyaṃ haihayeśituḥ //
1.77.d:
बाधाशतविनिर्मुक्तमस्तु मे भयवर्जितम् ।
बद्धेदं कवचं दिव्यमभेद्यं हैहयेशितुः ॥
1.77.m: may my body be free from a hundred afflictions and devoid of fear. / Having bound on this divine, impenetrable armour of the Haihaya lord,

1.77.s:
vicarāmi divā rātrau nirbhayenāntarātmanā /
rājamārge mahādurge mārge caurā disaṃkule //
1.77.d:
विचरामि दिवा रात्रौ निर्भयेनान्तरात्मना ।
राजमार्गे महादुर्गे मार्गे चौरा दिसंकुले ॥
1.77.m: I wander day and night with an inner self free from fear: / on the royal highway, in great fortresses, on paths infested with thieves and the like,

1.77.s:
viṣame vipine ghore dāvāgnau girikandare /
saṃgrāme śastrasaṃghāte siṃhavyāghraniṣevite //
1.77.d:
विषमे विपिने घोरे दावाग्नौ गिरिकन्दरे ।
संग्रामे शस्त्रसंघाते सिंहव्याघ्रनिषेविते ॥
1.77.m: in rough, terrible forests, in forest fires, in mountain caves, / in battle, amid the clash of weapons, where lions and tigers dwell,

1.77.s:
gahvare sarvasaṃkīrṇe saṃdhyākāle nṛpālaye /
vivāde vipulāvarte samudre ca nadītaṭe //
1.77.d:
गह्वरे सर्वसंकीर्णे संध्याकाले नृपालये ।
विवादे विपुलावर्ते समुद्रे च नदीतटे ॥
1.77.m: in deep abysses, in every chaos, at twilight, in the royal palace, / in disputes, in broad whirlpools, at sea, and on riverbanks,

1.77.s:
paripanthijanākīrṇe deśe dasyugaṇāvṛte /
sarvasvaharaṇe prāpte prāpte prāṇasya saṃkaṭe //
1.77.d:
परिपन्थिजनाकीर्णे देशे दस्युगणावृते ।
सर्वस्वहरणे प्राप्ते प्राप्ते प्राणस्य संकटे ॥
1.77.m: in places crowded with adversaries, in a land swarming with bands of bandits, / when my whole property is seized, when danger to my life has come,

1.77.s:
nānārogajvarāveśe piśācapretayātane /
mārīduḥsvapnapīḍāsu kliṣṭe viśvāsaghātake //
1.77.d:
नानारोगज्वरावेशे पिशाचप्रेतयातने ।
मारीदुःस्वप्नपीडासु क्लिष्टे विश्वासघातके ॥
1.77.m: in attacks of various diseases and fevers, in torments caused by Piśācas and Pretas, / during afflictions from pestilence and nightmares, when distressed by a traitor,

1.77.s:
śārīre ca mahāduḥkhe mānase ca mahājvare /
ādhivyādhibhaye vighnajvālopadravake 'pi ca //
1.77.d:
शारीरे च महादुःखे मानसे च महाज्वरे ।
आधिव्याधिभये विघ्नज्वालोपद्रवके ऽपि च ॥
1.77.m: in great bodily pain, in great mental fever, / in fear of mental grief and bodily illness, and even in calamities like flares of obstacles—

1.77.s:
na bhavatu bhayaṃ kiñcitkavacenāvṛtasya me /
āṅgutukāmānakhilānasmadvasuviluṃpakān //
1.77.d:
न भवतु भयं किञ्चित्कवचेनावृतस्य मे ।
आङ्गुतुकामानखिलानस्मद्वसुविलुंपकान् ॥
1.77.m: may no fear whatever come to me who am covered by this armour! / All those who wish to attack us, plundering our wealth,

1.77.s:
nivārayatu dordaṇḍasahasreṇa mahārathaḥ /
svakaroddhṛtasāhasrapāśabaddhānsudurjayān //
1.77.d:
निवारयतु दोर्दण्डसहस्रेण महारथः ।
स्वकरोद्धृतसाहस्रपाशबद्धान्सुदुर्जयान् ॥
1.77.m: may the great chariot-warrior ward off with his thousand arm-rods; / bound with a thousand nooses raised by his own hands, very difficult to conquer,

1.77.s:
saṃruddhūgatisāmarthyānkarotu kṛtavīryajaḥ /
sṛṇisāhasranirbhinnānsahasraśarakhaṇḍitān //
1.77.d:
संरुद्धूगतिसामर्थ्यान्करोतु कृतवीर्यजः ।
सृणिसाहस्रनिर्भिन्नान्सहस्रशरखण्डितान् ॥
1.77.m: may the son of Kṛtavīrya render their power to move obstructed; / pierced by thousands of elephant-goads, severed by thousands of arrows,

1.77.s:
rājacūḍāmaṇiḥ kṣipraṃ karotvasmadvirodhakān /
khaḍga sāhasradalitānsahasramuśalārditān //
1.77.d:
राजचूडामणिः क्षिप्रं करोत्वस्मद्विरोधकान् ।
खड्ग साहस्रदलितान्सहस्रमुशलार्दितान् ॥
1.77.m: may the crest-jewel of kings swiftly make our adversaries; / chopped by thousands of swords, crushed by thousands of maces,

1.77.s:
caurādi duṣṭasattvaughānkarotu kamalekṣaṇaḥ /
svaśaṅkhanādasaṃtrastānsahasrārasahasrabhṛt //
1.77.d:
चौरादि दुष्टसत्त्वौघान्करोतु कमलेक्षणः ।
स्वशङ्खनादसंत्रस्तान्सहस्रारसहस्रभृत् ॥
1.77.m: may the lotus-eyed one make the hosts of thieves and other wicked beings; / terrified by the sound of his conch, may he who bears thousands of thousand-spoked [discuses],

1.77.s:
avatāro hareḥ sākṣātpālayatvakhilaṃ mama /
kārtavīrya mahāvīrya sarvaduṣṭavināśana //
1.77.d:
अवतारो हरेः साक्षात्पालयत्वखिलं मम ।
कार्तवीर्य महावीर्य सर्वदुष्टविनाशन ॥
1.77.m: an avatar of Hari manifest, protect everything of mine! / O Kārtavīrya of great valour, destroyer of all the wicked,

1.77.s:
sarvatra sarvadā duṣṭacaurānnāśāya nāśaya /
kiṃ tvaṃ svapiṣi duṣṭaghna kiṃ tiṣṭasi cirāyāsi //
1.77.d:
सर्वत्र सर्वदा दुष्टचौरान्नाशाय नाशय ।
किं त्वं स्वपिषि दुष्टघ्न किं तिष्टसि चिरायासि ॥
1.77.m: destroy, destroy the wicked thieves everywhere and at all times! / Why do you sleep, O slayer of the wicked? Why do you wait and delay?

1.77.s:
uttiṣṭha pāhi naḥ sarvabhayebhyaḥ svasutāniva /
ye caurā vasuhartāro vidviṣo ye ca hiṃsakāḥ //
1.77.d:
उत्तिष्ठ पाहि नः सर्वभयेभ्यः स्वसुतानिव ।
ये चौरा वसुहर्तारो विद्विषो ये च हिंसकाः ॥
1.77.m: Arise, protect us from all fears as your own children! / Whichever thieves steal wealth, and whoever are enemies and injurers,

1.77.s:
sādhubhītikarā duṣṭāśchadmakā ye durāśayāḥ /
durhṛdo duṣṭabhū pālā duṣṭāmātyāśca pāpakāḥ //
1.77.d:
साधुभीतिकरा दुष्टाश्छद्मका ये दुराशयाः ।
दुर्हृदो दुष्टभू पाला दुष्टामात्याश्च पापकाः ॥
1.77.m: Those who cause fear to the virtuous, the wicked, the hypocrites who bear evil intent, / evil-hearted people, wicked kings, and wicked ministers who are sinful;

1.77.s:
ye ca kāryaviloptoro ye khalāḥ paripanthinaḥ /
sarvasvahāriṇāṃ ye ca pañca māyāvino 'pareḥ //
1.77.d:
ये च कार्यविलोप्तोरो ये खलाः परिपन्थिनः ।
सर्वस्वहारिणां ये च पञ्च मायाविनो ऽपरेः ॥
1.77.m: and those who ruin enterprises, the knaves, the highwaymen, / and those other five deceitful ones who rob all possessions;

1.77.s:
mahākleśakarā mlecchā dasyavo vṛṣalāśca ye /
ye 'gnidā garadātāro vañcakāḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ //
1.77.d:
महाक्लेशकरा म्लेच्छा दस्यवो वृषलाश्च ये ।
ये ऽग्निदा गरदातारो वञ्चकाः शस्त्रपाणयः ॥
1.77.m: the barbarians who cause great affliction, the bandits, and the outcasts; / those who set fires, poisoners, cheats, and those with weapons in hand;

1.77.s:
ye pāpā duṣṭakarmāṇo duḥkhadā duṣṭabuddhayaḥ /
vyājakāḥ kupathāsaktā ye ca nānābhayapradāḥ //
1.77.d:
ये पापा दुष्टकर्माणो दुःखदा दुष्टबुद्धयः ।
व्याजकाः कुपथासक्ता ये च नानाभयप्रदाः ॥
1.77.m: those who are sinful, evil-doing, grief-giving, and evil-minded; / deceivers, those clinging to wrong paths, and those who bring manifold terrors;

1.77.s:
chidrānveṣaratā nityaṃ ye 'smānbādhitumudyatāḥ /
te sarve kārtavīryasya mahāśaṅkharavāhatāḥ //
1.77.d:
छिद्रान्वेषरता नित्यं ये ऽस्मान्बाधितुमुद्यताः ।
ते सर्वे कार्तवीर्यस्य महाशङ्खरवाहताः ॥
1.77.m: those always intent on finding faults, who are resolved to torment us— / struck by the great blare of the conch of Kārtavīrya,

1.77.s:
sahasā vilayaṃ yāntu dūradiva vimohitāḥ /
ye dānavā mahādityā ye yakṣā ye ca rākṣasāḥ //
1.77.d:
सहसा विलयं यान्तु दूरदिव विमोहिताः ।
ये दानवा महादित्या ये यक्षा ये च राक्षसाः ॥
1.77.m: let them all swiftly go to destruction from afar, utterly bewildered! / The Dānavas, the great Daityas, the Yakṣas, and the Rākṣasas;

1.77.s:
piśācā ye mahāsattvā ye bhūtabrahmarākṣasāḥ /
apasmāragrahā ye ca ye grahāḥ piśitāśanāḥ //
1.77.d:
पिशाचा ये महासत्त्वा ये भूतब्रह्मराक्षसाः ।
अपस्मारग्रहा ये च ये ग्रहाः पिशिताशनाः ॥
1.77.m: the Piśācas who are mighty beings, the Bhūtas and Brahma-rākṣasas; / the epilepsy-spirits and the flesh-eating spirits;

1.77.s:
mahālohitabhoktāro vetālā ye ca guhyakāḥ /
gandharvāpsarasaḥ siddhā ye ca devādiyonayaḥ //
1.77.d:
महालोहितभोक्तारो वेताला ये च गुह्यकाः ।
गन्धर्वाप्सरसः सिद्धा ये च देवादियोनयः ॥
1.77.m: the drinkers of great quantities of blood, the Vetālas, and the Guhyakas; / Gandharvas, Apsarases, Siddhas, and classes of divine origin;

1.77.s:
ḍākinyo druṇasāḥ pretāḥ kṣetrapālā vināyakāḥ /
mahāvyāghramahāmeghā mahāturāgarūpakāḥ //
1.77.d:
डाकिन्यो द्रुणसाः प्रेताः क्षेत्रपाला विनायकाः ।
महाव्याघ्रमहामेघा महातुरागरूपकाः ॥
1.77.m: the Ḍākinīs, Druṇasas, Pretas, Kṣetrapālas, and Vināyakas; / those having the forms of great tigers, great clouds, and great horses;

1.77.s:
mahāgajā mahāsiṃhā mahāmahiṣayonayaḥ /
ṛkṣavārāhaśunakavānarolūkamūrtayaḥ //
1.77.d:
महागजा महासिंहा महामहिषयोनयः ।
ऋक्षवाराहशुनकवानरोलूकमूर्तयः ॥
1.77.m: those having the origin of great elephants, great lions, and great buffaloes; / those having the shapes of bears, boars, dogs, monkeys, and owls;

1.77.s:
mahoṣṭrakharamārjārasarpagovṛṣamastakāḥ /
nānārūpā mahāsattvā nānākleśasahasradāḥ //
1.77.d:
महोष्ट्रखरमार्जारसर्पगोवृषमस्तकाः ।
नानारूपा महासत्त्वा नानाक्लेशसहस्रदाः ॥
1.77.m: those with the heads of great camels, donkeys, cats, snakes, cows, and bulls; / manifold forms, mighty beings that inflict thousands of various afflictions;

1.77.s:
nānārogakarāḥ kṣudrā mahāvīryā mahābalāḥ /
vātikāḥ paittikā ghorā ślaiṣmikāḥ sānnipātikāḥ //
1.77.d:
नानारोगकराः क्षुद्रा महावीर्या महाबलाः ।
वातिकाः पैत्तिका घोरा श्लैष्मिकाः सान्निपातिकाः ॥
1.77.m: those causing various diseases, the vile, the vastly potent and very strong; / frightful wind-born, bile-born, phlegm-born, and tridoshic afflictions;

1.77.s:
māheśvarā vaiṣṇavāśca vairiñcyāśca mahāgrahāḥ /
skāndā vaināyakāḥ krūrā ye ca pramathaguhyakāḥ //
1.77.d:
माहेश्वरा वैष्णवाश्च वैरिञ्च्याश्च महाग्रहाः ।
स्कान्दा वैनायकाः क्रूरा ये च प्रमथगुह्यकाः ॥
1.77.m: the great spirits sacred to Maheśvara, to Viṣṇu, and to Brahmā; / the cruel ones sacred to Skanda, to Vināyaka, and the Guhyakas among the Pramathas;

1.77.s:
mahāśatruhā raudrā mahāmārīmasūrikāḥ /
aikāhikā vdyāhikāśca tryāhikāśca mahājvarāḥ //
1.77.d:
महाशत्रुहा रौद्रा महामारीमसूरिकाः ।
ऐकाहिका व्द्याहिकाश्च त्र्याहिकाश्च महाज्वराः ॥
1.77.m: the fierce slayers of great enemies, the great plagues and smallpox; / the great fevers recurring daily, every two days, and every three days;

1.77.s:
cāturthikāḥ pākṣikāśca māsyāḥ ṣāṇmāsikāśca ye /
sāṃvatsarā durnivāryā jvarāḥ paramadāruṇāḥ //
1.77.d:
चातुर्थिकाः पाक्षिकाश्च मास्याः षाण्मासिकाश्च ये ।
सांवत्सरा दुर्निवार्या ज्वराः परमदारुणाः ॥
1.77.m: the fevers recurring every fourth day, every fortnight, every month, every six months, / and yearly, hard to avert and exceedingly terrible;

1.77.s:
svāpnikā ye mahotpātā ye ca duḥsvāpnikā grahāḥ /
kūṣmāṇḍā jṛṃbhikā bhaumā droṇāḥ sānnidhyavañcakāḥ //
1.77.d:
स्वाप्निका ये महोत्पाता ये च दुःस्वाप्निका ग्रहाः ।
कूष्माण्डा जृंभिका भौमा द्रोणाः सान्निध्यवञ्चकाः ॥
1.77.m: the great portents seen in dreams, and the evil-dream spirits; / the Kūṣmāṇḍas, Jṛmbhakas, earth-spirits, Droṇas, and presence-cheaters;

1.77.s:
bhramikāḥ prāṇahartāro ye ca bālagrahādayaḥ /
manobudvīndriyaharāḥ sphoṭakāśca mahāgrahāḥ //
1.77.d:
भ्रमिकाः प्राणहर्तारो ये च बालग्रहादयः ।
मनोबुद्वीन्द्रियहराः स्फोटकाश्च महाग्रहाः ॥
1.77.m: the dizziness-causing, life-robbing, and child-afflicting spirits; / the great spirits that rob the mind, intellect, and senses, and those causing eruptions;

1.77.s:
mahāśanā balibhujo mahākuṇapabhojanāḥ /
divācarā rātricarā ye ca saṃdhyāsu dāruṇāḥ //
1.77.d:
महाशना बलिभुजो महाकुणपभोजनाः ।
दिवाचरा रात्रिचरा ये च संध्यासु दारुणाः ॥
1.77.m: great devourers, oblation-eaters, feeders on great corpses; / roaming by day, roaming by night, and terrible in the twilights;

1.77.s:
pramattā vāpramattā vai ye māṃ bādhitumudyatāḥ /
te sarve kārttavīryasya dhanurmuktaśarāhatāḥ //
1.77.d:
प्रमत्ता वाप्रमत्ता वै ये मां बाधितुमुद्यताः ।
ते सर्वे कार्त्तवीर्यस्य धनुर्मुक्तशराहताः ॥
1.77.m: whether negligent or attentive, whoever are resolved to torment me— / struck down by the arrows loosed from the bow of Kārtavīrya,

1.77.s:
sahasradhā praṇaśyantu bhagnasattvabalodyamāḥ /
ye sarpā ye mahānāgā mahāgiribileśayāḥ //
1.77.d:
सहस्रधा प्रणश्यन्तु भग्नसत्त्वबलोद्यमाः ।
ये सर्पा ये महानागा महागिरिबिलेशयाः ॥
1.77.m: let them all perish in a thousand ways, their vitality, strength, and effort shattered! / The serpents, the great nāgas dwelling in the caves of great mountains;

1.77.s:
kālavyālā mahādaṃṣṭrā mahājagarasaṃjñakāḥ /
anantaśūlikādyāśca daṃṣṭrāviṣamahābhayāḥ //
1.77.d:
कालव्याला महादंष्ट्रा महाजगरसंज्ञकाः ।
अनन्तशूलिकाद्याश्च दंष्ट्राविषमहाभयाः ॥
1.77.m: the black serpents of death, large-fanged, known as great pythons; / those beginning with the Anantaśūlikas, terrifically fearsome with poisonous fangs;

1.77.s:
anekaśata śīrṣāśca khaṇḍapucchāśca dāruṇāḥ /
mahāviṣajalaukāśca vṛścikā ruktapucchakāḥ //
1.77.d:
अनेकशत शीर्षाश्च खण्डपुच्छाश्च दारुणाः ।
महाविषजलौकाश्च वृश्चिका रुक्तपुच्छकाः ॥
1.77.m: those with many hundreds of heads, those with broken tails, the frightful ones; / leeches of deadly venom, and scorpions with red tails;

1.77.s:
āśīviṣāḥ kālakūṭā mahāhālāhalāhvayāḥ /
jalasarpā jalavyālā jalagrāhāśca kacchapāḥ //
1.77.d:
आशीविषाः कालकूटा महाहालाहलाह्वयाः ।
जलसर्पा जलव्याला जलग्राहाश्च कच्छपाः ॥
1.77.m: furious vipers, deadly kālakūṭa serpents, those called great hālāhalas; / water-serpents, water-vipers, water-crocodiles, and turtles;

1.77.s:
matsyakā viṣapucchāśca ye cānye jalavāsinaḥ /
jalajāḥ sthalajāścaiva kṛtrimāśca mahāviṣāḥ //
1.77.d:
मत्स्यका विषपुच्छाश्च ये चान्ये जलवासिनः ।
जलजाः स्थलजाश्चैव कृत्रिमाश्च महाविषाः ॥
1.77.m: fish, those with venomous tails, and whatever other water-dwellers; / water-born, land-born, and artificial, highly venomous creatures;

1.77.s:
guptarūpā guptaviṣā mūṣikā gṛhagodhikāḥ /
nānāviṣāśca ye ghorā mahopaviṣasaṃjñakāḥ //
1.77.d:
गुप्तरूपा गुप्तविषा मूषिका गृहगोधिकाः ।
नानाविषाश्च ये घोरा महोपविषसंज्ञकाः ॥
1.77.m: rats and house-geckos of hidden forms and concealed poisons; / and whatever terrible ones have various venoms, termed great minor poisons;

1.77.s:
ye 'smānbādhitumicchanti śarīraprāṇanāśakāḥ /
te sarve kārtavīryasya khaṅkasāhasradāritāḥ //
1.77.d:
ये ऽस्मान्बाधितुमिच्छन्ति शरीरप्राणनाशकाः ।
ते सर्वे कार्तवीर्यस्य खङ्कसाहस्रदारिताः ॥
1.77.m: those who wish to torment us, destroying body and vital breath— / torn apart by the thousand swords of Kārtavīrya,

1.77.s:
dūrādeva vinaśyantu praṇaṣṭendriyasāhasāḥ /
manuṣyāḥ paśavo tvṛkṣavānarā vanagocarāḥ //
1.77.d:
दूरादेव विनश्यन्तु प्रणष्टेन्द्रियसाहसाः ।
मनुष्याः पशवो त्वृक्षवानरा वनगोचराः ॥
1.77.m: let them all perish from afar, their senses and courage ruined! / Humans, animals, bears, monkeys, and forest-dwellers;

1.77.s:
siṃhavyāghravarāhāśca mahiṣā ye mahāmṛgāḥ /
gajāsturaṅgā gavayā rāsabhāḥ śarabhā vṛkāḥ //
1.77.d:
सिंहव्याघ्रवराहाश्च महिषा ये महामृगाः ।
गजास्तुरङ्गा गवया रासभाः शरभा वृकाः ॥
1.77.m: lions, tigers, boars, buffaloes, and great wild beasts; / elephants, horses, gayals, donkeys, śarabhas, wolves;

1.77.s:
śunakā dvīpinaḥ śubhrā mārjārā bilalolupāḥ /
śṛgālāḥ śaśakāḥ śyenā gurutmanto vihṝṅgamāḥ //
1.77.d:
शुनका द्वीपिनः शुभ्रा मार्जारा बिललोलुपाः ।
शृगालाः शशकाः श्येना गुरुत्मन्तो विहॄङ्गमाः ॥
1.77.m: dogs, leopards, white cats covetous of holes; / jackals, hares, hawks, garuḍa-birds, winged creatures;

1.77.s:
bheruṇḍā vāyasā gūdhrā haṃsādyāḥ pakṣijātayaḥ /
udbhijjāścāṇḍajāścaiva svedajāśca jarāyujāḥ //
1.77.d:
भेरुण्डा वायसा गूध्रा हंसाद्याः पक्षिजातयः ।
उद्भिज्जाश्चाण्डजाश्चैव स्वेदजाश्च जरायुजाः ॥
1.77.m: bheruṇḍa birds, crows, vultures, swans, and other kinds of birds; / whether born of plants, born of eggs, sweat-born, or womb-born;

1.77.s:
nānābhedakule jātā nānābhedāḥ pṛthagvidhāḥ /
ye 'smānbādhitumicchanti sedhyāsu ca divā niśi //
1.77.d:
नानाभेदकुले जाता नानाभेदाः पृथग्विधाः ।
ये ऽस्मान्बाधितुमिच्छन्ति सेध्यासु च दिवा निशि ॥
1.77.m: born in manifold distinct species, multifarious and of diverse kinds; / whoever wish to torment us in the twilights, by day, or by night—

1.77.s:
te sarve kārtavīryasya gadāsāhasradāritāḥ /
dūrādeva vinaśyantu vinaṣṭagatipauruṣāḥ //
1.77.d:
ते सर्वे कार्तवीर्यस्य गदासाहस्रदारिताः ।
दूरादेव विनश्यन्तु विनष्टगतिपौरुषाः ॥
1.77.m: torn apart by the thousand maces of Kārtavīrya, / let them all perish from afar, their power and prowess destroyed!

1.77.s:
ye cākṣemapradātāraḥ kūṭamāyāvinaśca ye /
māraṇotsādanonmūladveṣamohanakārakāḥ //
1.77.d:
ये चाक्षेमप्रदातारः कूटमायाविनश्च ये ।
मारणोत्सादनोन्मूलद्वेषमोहनकारकाः ॥
1.77.m: Those who bestow distress, and those deceitful with fraudulent tricks; / who perform rites of killing, driving away, uprooting, enmity, and delusion;

1.77.s:
viśvāsa ghātakā duṣṭā ye ca svāmidruho narāḥ /
ye cātatāyino duṣṭā ye pāpā gopyahāriṇaḥ //
1.77.d:
विश्वास घातका दुष्टा ये च स्वामिद्रुहो नराः ।
ये चाततायिनो दुष्टा ये पापा गोप्यहारिणः ॥
1.77.m: wicked betrayers of trust, and men who injure their masters; / those wicked felons, and the sinners who rob secrets;

1.77.s:
dāhopadyātagaralaśastrapātātiduḥkhadāḥ /
kṣetravittādiharaṇabandhanādibhayapradāḥ //
1.77.d:
दाहोपद्यातगरलशस्त्रपातातिदुःखदाः ।
क्षेत्रवित्तादिहरणबन्धनादिभयप्रदाः ॥
1.77.m: those who inflict intense suffering by fire, calamity, poison, and falling weapons; / who bring fear through the seizure of land, wealth, and through imprisonment;

1.77.s:
ītayo vividhākāro ye cānye duṣṭajātayaḥ /
pīḍākarā ye satataṃ chidramicchanti bādhitum //
1.77.d:
ईतयो विविधाकारो ये चान्ये दुष्टजातयः ।
पीडाकरा ये सततं छिद्रमिच्छन्ति बाधितुम् ॥
1.77.m: pestilences of manifold forms, and whatever other wicked breeds; / tormentors who continually seek a weakness to cause injury—

1.77.s:
te sarve kārtavīryasya cakrasāhasradāritāḥ /
dūrādeva kṣayaṃ yāntu vinaṣṭabalasāhasāḥ //
1.77.d:
ते सर्वे कार्तवीर्यस्य चक्रसाहस्रदारिताः ।
दूरादेव क्षयं यान्तु विनष्टबलसाहसाः ॥
1.77.m: torn apart by the thousand discs of Kārtavīrya, / let them all go to ruin from afar, their strength and courage destroyed!

1.77.s:
ye meghā ye mahāvarṣā ye vātā yāśca vidyutaḥ /
ye mahāśanayo dīptā ye nirghātāśca dāruṇāḥ //
1.77.d:
ये मेघा ये महावर्षा ये वाता याश्च विद्युतः ।
ये महाशनयो दीप्ता ये निर्घाताश्च दारुणाः ॥
1.77.m: Clouds, heavy downpours, winds, and lightnings; / blazing thunderbolts, and terrifying violent gusts;

1.77.s:
ulkāpātāśca ye ghorā ye mahendrāyudhādayaḥ /
sūryendukujasaumyāśca gurukāvyaśanaiścarāḥ //
1.77.d:
उल्कापाताश्च ये घोरा ये महेन्द्रायुधादयः ।
सूर्येन्दुकुजसौम्याश्च गुरुकाव्यशनैश्चराः ॥
1.77.m:
And whatever terrible falling meteors [there may be], whatever rainbows and other wonders [there may be],
and the Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, and Saturn;

1.77.s:
rāhuśca ketavo ghorā nakṣatrā rāśayastathā /
tithayaḥ saṃkramā māsā hāyanā yuganāyakāḥ //
1.77.d:
राहुश्च केतवो घोरा नक्षत्रा राशयस्तथा ।
तिथयः संक्रमा मासा हायना युगनायकाः ॥
1.77.m:
and Rāhu and the terrible Ketus, the lunar mansions, and likewise the zodiacal signs,
the lunar days, planetary transits, months, years, and the lords of the yugas;

1.77.s:
manvantarādhipāḥ siddhā ṛṣayo yogasiddhayaḥ /
nidhayo ṛgyajuḥsāmātharvāṇaścaiva vahnayaḥ //
1.77.d:
मन्वन्तराधिपाः सिद्धा ऋषयो योगसिद्धयः ।
निधयो ऋग्यजुःसामाथर्वाणश्चैव वह्नयः ॥
1.77.m:
the rulers of the Manvantaras, the Siddhas, the sages, the yogic accomplishments,
the treasures, the Ṛg, Yajur, Sāma, and Atharva [Vedas], and indeed the fires;

1.77.s:
ṛtavo lokapālāśca pitaro devasaṃhatiḥ /
vidyāścaiva catuḥṣaṣṭibhedā yā bhuvanatraye //
1.77.d:
ऋतवो लोकपालाश्च पितरो देवसंहतिः ।
विद्याश्चैव चतुःषष्टिभेदा या भुवनत्रये ॥
1.77.m:
the seasons, the world-protectors, the ancestors, the host of gods,
and the lores in their sixty-four varieties in the three worlds—

1.77.s:
ye tvatra kīrtitāḥ sarve caye cānye nānukīrtitāḥ /
te saṃtu naḥ sadā saumyāḥ sarvakālasukhāvahāḥ //
1.77.d:
ये त्वत्र कीर्तिताः सर्वे चये चान्ये नानुकीर्तिताः ।
ते संतु नः सदा सौम्याः सर्वकालसुखावहाः ॥
1.77.m:
all those who have been celebrated here, and those others who have not been mentioned,
may they always be benevolent to us, bringing happiness at all times,

1.77.s:
ājñayā kārtavīryasya yogīndrasyāmitadyuteḥ /
kārtavīryārjuno dhanvī rājendro haihayeśvaraḥ //
1.77.d:
आज्ञया कार्तवीर्यस्य योगीन्द्रस्यामितद्युतेः ।
कार्तवीर्यार्जुनो धन्वी राजेन्द्रो हैहयेश्वरः ॥
1.77.m:
by the command of Kārtavīrya, the lord of yogins, of boundless splendor!
Kārtavīryārjuna, the archer, the king of kings, the lord of the Haihayas,

1.77.s:
daśāsyadarpahā revālīlādṛptakaḥ sudurjayaḥ /
duḥkhahā cauradamano rājarājeśvaraḥ prabhuḥ //
1.77.d:
दशास्यदर्पहा रेवालीलादृप्तकः सुदुर्जयः ।
दुःखहा चौरदमनो राजराजेश्वरः प्रभुः ॥
1.77.m:
the crusher of the pride of the Ten-faced One, arrogant with sport upon the Revā, very hard to conquer,
the remover of sorrow, the subduer of thieves, the sovereign lord of kings, the protector;

1.77.s:
sarvajñaḥ sarvadaḥ śrīmān sarvaśiṣṭeṣṭadaḥ kṛtī /
rājacūḍāmaṇiryogī saptadvīpādhināyakaḥ //
1.77.d:
सर्वज्ञः सर्वदः श्रीमान् सर्वशिष्टेष्टदः कृती ।
राजचूडामणिर्योगी सप्तद्वीपाधिनायकः ॥
1.77.m:
the omniscient, the all-giver, the glorious, the granter of the desires of all good men, the accomplished,
the crest-jewel of kings, the yogin, the supreme leader over the seven continents;

1.77.s:
vijayī viśvajidvāgmī mahāgatiralolupaḥ /
yajvā viprapriyo vidvān brahmajñeyaḥ sanātanaḥ //
1.77.d:
विजयी विश्वजिद्वाग्मी महागतिरलोलुपः ।
यज्वा विप्रप्रियो विद्वान् ब्रह्मज्ञेयः सनातनः ॥
1.77.m:
the victorious, conqueror of all, eloquent, whose course is vast, free from greed,
the performer of sacrifices, dear to brāhmaṇas, wise, known through Brahman, eternal;

1.77.s:
māhiṣmatīpatiryodhā mahākīrtirmahābhujaḥ /
sukumāro mahāvīro mārīghno madirekṣaṇaḥ //
1.77.d:
माहिष्मतीपतिर्योधा महाकीर्तिर्महाभुजः ।
सुकुमारो महावीरो मारीघ्नो मदिरेक्षणः ॥
1.77.m:
the lord of Māhiṣmatī, the warrior, of great renown, long-armed,
youthful, the great hero, the destroyer of pestilence, whose eyes are intoxicating;

1.77.s:
śatrughnaḥ śāśvataḥ śūraḥ śaṅkhabhṛdyogivallabhaḥ /
mahābhāgavato dhīmānmahābhayavināśanaḥ //
1.77.d:
शत्रुघ्नः शाश्वतः शूरः शङ्खभृद्योगिवल्लभः ।
महाभागवतो धीमान्महाभयविनाशनः ॥
1.77.m:
the slayer of enemies, perpetual, heroic, bearer of the conch, beloved of yogins,
the great devotee of the Blessed Lord, intelligent, the destroyer of great fear;

1.77.s:
asādhyī vigraho divyo bhāvo vyāptajagattrayaḥ /
jitendriyo jitārātiḥ svacchando 'nantavikramamaḥ //
1.77.d:
असाध्यी विग्रहो दिव्यो भावो व्याप्तजगत्त्रयः ।
जितेन्द्रियो जितारातिः स्वच्छन्दो ऽनन्तविक्रममः ॥
1.77.m:
invincible, divine of body, whose nature pervades the three worlds,
who has mastered his senses, subdued his foes, self-willed, of boundless valor;

1.77.s:
cakrabhṛtparacakraghnaḥ saṃgrāmavidhipūjitaḥ /
sarvaśāstrakalādharī virajā lokavanditaḥ //
1.77.d:
चक्रभृत्परचक्रघ्नः संग्रामविधिपूजितः ।
सर्वशास्त्रकलाधरी विरजा लोकवन्दितः ॥
1.77.m:
the bearer of the discus, slayer of enemy armies, honored according to the rules of battle,
holder of all arts and sciences, stainless, praised by the world;

1.77.s:
vīro vimalasattvāḍhyo mahābalaparākramaḥ /
vijayaśrīmahāmānyo jitārirmantranāyakaḥ //
1.77.d:
वीरो विमलसत्त्वाढ्यो महाबलपराक्रमः ।
विजयश्रीमहामान्यो जितारिर्मन्त्रनायकः ॥
1.77.m:
the hero, abundant in pure goodness, of great strength and prowess,
greatly honored by the goddess of victory, conqueror of foes, leader of mantras;

1.77.s:
khaḍgabhṛtkāmadaḥ kāntaḥ kālaghnaḥ kamalekṣaṇaḥ /
bhadravādapriyo vaidyo vibudho varado vaśī //
1.77.d:
खड्गभृत्कामदः कान्तः कालघ्नः कमलेक्षणः ।
भद्रवादप्रियो वैद्यो विबुधो वरदो वशी ॥
1.77.m:
the bearer of the sword, grantor of desires, lovely, destroyer of death, lotus-eyed,
fond of auspicious speech, the physician, wise, boon-giver, self-controlled;

1.77.s:
mahādhano nidhipatirmahāyogī gurupriyaḥ /
yogāḍhyaḥ sarvarogaghno rājitākhilabhūtalaḥ //
1.77.d:
महाधनो निधिपतिर्महायोगी गुरुप्रियः ।
योगाढ्यः सर्वरोगघ्नो राजिताखिलभूतलः ॥
1.77.m:
exceedingly wealthy, lord of treasures, the great yogin, dear to his guru,
endowed with yoga, destroyer of all diseases, illuminator of the entire surface of the earth;

1.77.s:
divyāstrabhṛdameyātmā sarvagoptā mahojjvalaḥ /
sarvāyudhadharo 'bhīṣṭapradaḥ parapurañjayaḥ //
1.77.d:
दिव्यास्त्रभृदमेयात्मा सर्वगोप्ता महोज्ज्वलः ।
सर्वायुधधरो ऽभीष्टप्रदः परपुरञ्जयः ॥
1.77.m:
wielder of celestial weapons, immeasurable of soul, protector of all, supremely radiant,
bearer of all arms, granter of wished-for boons, conqueror of enemy cities;

1.77.s:
yogasiddho mahākāyo mahāvṛndaśatādhipaḥ /
sarvajñānanidhiḥ sarvasiddhvidānakṛtodyamaḥ //
1.77.d:
योगसिद्धो महाकायो महावृन्दशताधिपः ।
सर्वज्ञाननिधिः सर्वसिद्ध्विदानकृतोद्यमः ॥
1.77.m:
accomplished in yoga, of immense body, lord over hundreds of great hosts,
treasure-house of all knowledge, exerting effort in granting all supernatural powers—

1.77.s:
ityaṣṭaśatanāmottyā mūrtayo daśa dikpathi /
samyagdaśadiśo vyāpya pālayantu ca māṃ sadā //
1.77.d:
इत्यष्टशतनामोत्त्या मूर्तयो दश दिक्पथि ।
सम्यग्दशदिशो व्याप्य पालयन्तु च मां सदा ॥
1.77.m:
thus by the utterance of the one hundred and eight names, may [his] ten forms along the paths of the directions,
thoroughly pervading the ten directions, protect me always!

1.77.s:
svasthāḥ sarvendriyāḥ saṃtuṃ śāntirastu sadā mama /
śeṣādyā mūrtayo 'ṣṭau ca vikrameṇaiva bhāsvarāḥ //
1.77.d:
स्वस्थाः सर्वेन्द्रियाः संतुं शान्तिरस्तु सदा मम ।
शेषाद्या मूर्तयो ऽष्टौ च विक्रमेणैव भास्वराः ॥
1.77.m:
May all my senses be healthy! May peace be mine forever!
And may the eight forms beginning with Śeṣa, brilliant through their valor,

1.77.s:
agninirṛtivāyvīśakoṇagāḥ pāntu māṃ sadā /
mama saukhyamasaṃbādhamārogyamaparājayaḥ //
1.77.d:
अग्निनिरृतिवाय्वीशकोणगाः पान्तु मां सदा ।
मम सौख्यमसंबाधमारोग्यमपराजयः ॥
1.77.m:
situated in the intermediate corners of fire, Nirṛti, the wind, and Īśa, protect me always!
May there be my happiness, freedom from constriction, health, and unconquerability;

1.77.s:
duḥkhahāniravighnaśca prajāvṛddhiḥ sukho dayaḥ /
vāñchāptiratikalyāṇamavaiṣamyamanāmayam //
1.77.d:
दुःखहानिरविघ्नश्च प्रजावृद्धिः सुखो दयः ।
वाञ्छाप्तिरतिकल्याणमवैषम्यमनामयम् ॥
1.77.m:
cessation of grief, freedom from obstacles, increase of progeny, rising of joy,
attainment of desires, supreme welfare, impartiality, freedom from sickness;

1.77.s:
anālasyamabhīṣṭaṃ syānmṛtyuhānirbalonnatiḥ /
bhayahāniryaśaḥ kāntirvidyā ṛddhirmahāśriyaḥ //
1.77.d:
अनालस्यमभीष्टं स्यान्मृत्युहानिर्बलोन्नतिः ।
भयहानिर्यशः कान्तिर्विद्या ऋद्धिर्महाश्रियः ॥
1.77.m:
freedom from indolence; may what is desired come to be: destruction of death, increase of strength,
destruction of fear, fame, charm, knowledge, prosperity, and great riches;

1.77.s:
anaṣṭadravyatā caiva naṣṭasya punarāgamaḥ /
dīrghāyuṣyaṃ manoharṣaḥ saukumāryamabhīpsitam //
1.77.d:
अनष्टद्रव्यता चैव नष्टस्य पुनरागमः ।
दीर्घायुष्यं मनोहर्षः सौकुमार्यमभीप्सितम् ॥
1.77.m:
non-loss of goods, and the return of what was lost,
long life, joy of mind, desired youthfulness,

1.77.s:
apradhṛṣyatamatvaṃ ca mahāsāmarthyameva ca /
saṃtu me kārtavīryyasya haihayendrasya kīrtanāt //
1.77.d:
अप्रधृष्यतमत्वं च महासामर्थ्यमेव च ।
संतु मे कार्तवीर्य्यस्य हैहयेन्द्रस्य कीर्तनात् ॥
1.77.m:
extreme unassailability, and great capacity—
may these be mine from reciting the praises of Kārtavīrya, the lord of the Haihayas!

1.77.s:
ya idaṃ kārtavīryyasya kavaca puṇyavarddhanam /
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvopadravanāśanam //
1.77.d:
य इदं कार्तवीर्य्यस्य कवच पुण्यवर्द्धनम् ।
सर्वपापप्रशमनं सर्वोपद्रवनाशनम् ॥
1.77.m:
Whoever [recites] this armor of Kārtavīrya, which increases merit,
pacifies all sins, and destroys all afflictions;

1.77.s:
sarvaśāntikaraṃ guhyaṃ samastabhayanāśanam /
vijayārthapradaṃ nṝṇāṃ sarvasaṃpatpradaṃ śubham //
1.77.d:
सर्वशान्तिकरं गुह्यं समस्तभयनाशनम् ।
विजयार्थप्रदं नॄणां सर्वसंपत्प्रदं शुभम् ॥
1.77.m:
which brings all peace, is secret, destroys all fears,
grants victory and wealth to mortals, and bestows all auspicious fortune—

1.77.s:
śṛṇuyādvā paṭhedvāpi sarvakāmānavāpnuyāt /
caurairhṛtaṃ yadā paśyetpaśvādidhanamātmanaḥ //
1.77.d:
शृणुयाद्वा पठेद्वापि सर्वकामानवाप्नुयात् ।
चौरैर्हृतं यदा पश्येत्पश्वादिधनमात्मनः ॥
1.77.m:
whether one listens to it or recites it, one attains all desires.
When one sees one's own wealth, such as cattle, stolen by thieves,

1.77.s:
saptavāraṃ tadā japyenniśi paścimadiṅmukhaḥ /
saptarātreṇa labhate naṣṭadravyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ //
1.77.d:
सप्तवारं तदा जप्येन्निशि पश्चिमदिङ्मुखः ।
सप्तरात्रेण लभते नष्टद्रव्यं न संशयः ॥
1.77.m:
one should then recite it seven times at night, facing the western quarter:
within seven nights one recovers the lost property, without a doubt.

1.77.s:
saptaviṃśatidhā japtvā prācīdigvadanaḥ pumān /
devāsuranibhaṃ cāpi paracakraṃ nivārayet //
1.77.d:
सप्तविंशतिधा जप्त्वा प्राचीदिग्वदनः पुमान् ।
देवासुरनिभं चापि परचक्रं निवारयेत् ॥
1.77.m:
Reciting it twenty-seven times facing the eastern quarter, a man
repels an enemy host, even one resembling gods and asuras.

1.77.s:
vivāde kalaheghore pañcadhā yaḥ paṭhedidam /
vijayo jāyate tasya na kadācitparājayaḥ //
1.77.d:
विवादे कलहेघोरे पञ्चधा यः पठेदिदम् ।
विजयो जायते तस्य न कदाचित्पराजयः ॥
1.77.m:
Whoever recites this five times in a lawsuit or a fierce dispute,
to him belongs victory, never defeat.

1.77.s:
sarvarogaprapīḍāsu tredhā vā pañcadhā paṭhet /
sa rogamṛtyuvetālabhūtapretairna bādhyate //
1.77.d:
सर्वरोगप्रपीडासु त्रेधा वा पञ्चधा पठेत् ।
स रोगमृत्युवेतालभूतप्रेतैर्न बाध्यते ॥
1.77.m:
In times of distress from any disease, one should recite it three or five times:
he is not afflicted by disease, death, vetālas, bhūtas, or pretas.

1.77.s:
samyagdvādaśādhā rātrau prajapedbandhamuktaye /
tridinānnigaḍādūddhvo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ //
1.77.d:
सम्यग्द्वादशाधा रात्रौ प्रजपेद्बन्धमुक्तये ।
त्रिदिनान्निगडादूद्ध्वो मुच्यते नात्र संशयः ॥
1.77.m:
One should recite it well twelve times at night for release from bondage:
after three days he is freed from his fetters, of this there is no doubt.

1.77.s:
anenaiva vidhānena sarvasādhanakarmaṇi /
asādhyamapi saptāhātsādhayenmantravittamaḥ //
1.77.d:
अनेनैव विधानेन सर्वसाधनकर्मणि ।
असाध्यमपि सप्ताहात्साधयेन्मन्त्रवित्तमः ॥
1.77.m:
By this very procedure, in all ritual operations of accomplishment,
even the unachievable may be accomplished within seven days by one who knows the mantras best.

1.77.s:
yātrākāle paṭhitvedaṃ mārge gacchati yaḥ pumān /
na duṣṭacauravyāghrādyairbhayaṃ syātparipanthibhiḥ //
1.77.d:
यात्राकाले पठित्वेदं मार्गे गच्छति यः पुमान् ।
न दुष्टचौरव्याघ्राद्यैर्भयं स्यात्परिपन्थिभिः ॥
1.77.m:
The man who departs on a path at the time of a journey having recited this,
shall have no fear from vile thieves, tigers, or highway robbers.

1.77.s:
japannāsecanaṃ kurvañjalenāñjalinā tanau /
na cāsau viṣakṛtyādirogasphoṭaiḥ prabādhyate //
1.77.d:
जपन्नासेचनं कुर्वञ्जलेनाञ्जलिना तनौ ।
न चासौ विषकृत्यादिरोगस्फोटैः प्रबाध्यते ॥
1.77.m:
Reciting it while pouring water over the body with the cupped hands,
he is not afflicted by poison, sorcery, disease, or eruptions.

1.77.s:
kārtavīryaḥ khaladveṣī kṛtavīryasuto balī /
sahasrabāhuḥ śatrughno raktavāsā dhanurdharaḥ //
1.77.d:
कार्तवीर्यः खलद्वेषी कृतवीर्यसुतो बली ।
सहस्रबाहुः शत्रुघ्नो रक्तवासा धनुर्धरः ॥
1.77.m:
Kārtavīrya, hater of the wicked, son of Kṛtavīrya, powerful,
thousand-armed, slayer of enemies, clad in red garments, bearer of the bow,

1.77.s:
raktagandhoraktamālyo rājā smarturabhīṣṭadaḥ /
dvādaśaitāni nāmāni kārtavīryasya yaḥ paṭhet //
1.77.d:
रक्तगन्धोरक्तमाल्यो राजा स्मर्तुरभीष्टदः ।
द्वादशैतानि नामानि कार्तवीर्यस्य यः पठेत् ॥
1.77.m:
anointed with red perfumes, wearing red garlands, the king who grants the desires of one who remembers him:
whoever recites these twelve names of Kārtavīrya,

1.77.s:
saṃpadastasya jāyante janāstasya vaśe sadā /
yaḥ sevate sadā vipra śrīmañcakrāvatārakam //
1.77.d:
संपदस्तस्य जायन्ते जनास्तस्य वशे सदा ।
यः सेवते सदा विप्र श्रीमञ्चक्रावतारकम् ॥
1.77.m:
to him belong prosperities, people are always under his sway.
Whoever continually serves the glorious incarnation of the Discus, O brāhmaṇa,

1.77.s:
tasya rakṣāṃ sadā kuryāñcakraṃ viṣṇormahātmanaḥ /
mayaitatkavacaṃ vipra dattātreyānmunīśvarāt //
1.77.d:
तस्य रक्षां सदा कुर्याञ्चक्रं विष्णोर्महात्मनः ।
मयैतत्कवचं विप्र दत्तात्रेयान्मुनीश्वरात् ॥
1.77.m:
the discus of high-souled Viṣṇu will always protect him.
This armor was heard by me, O brāhmaṇa, from Dattātreya, the lord of sages;

1.77.s:
śrutaṃ tubhyaṃ nigaditaṃ dhārayasvākhileṣṭadam //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne tṛtīyapāde kārtavīryakavacakathanaṃ nāma saptasaptatitomo 'dhyāyaḥ
1.77.d:
श्रुतं तुभ्यं निगदितं धारयस्वाखिलेष्टदम् ॥
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने तृतीयपादे कार्तवीर्यकवचकथनं नाम सप्तसप्ततितोमो ऽध्यायः
1.77.m:
it has been declared to you; keep it, for it grants all desires!

Thus ends the seventy-seventh chapter, entitled 'The Proclamation of the Armor of Kārtavīrya', in the third quarter of the Bṛhadupākhyāna in the first part of the venerable Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.

1.78.s:
sanatkumāra uvāca
kārtavīryasya kavacaṃ kathitaṃ te munīśvara /
mohavidhvaṃsanaṃ jaitraṃ māruteḥ kavacaṃ śṛṇu //
1.78.d:
सनत्कुमार उवाच
कार्तवीर्यस्य कवचं कथितं ते मुनीश्वर ।
मोहविध्वंसनं जैत्रं मारुतेः कवचं शृणु ॥

1.78.s:
yasya saṃdhāraṇātsadyaḥ sarve naśyantyupadravāḥ /
bhūtapretārijaṃ duḥkhaṃ nāśameti na saṃśayaḥ //
1.78.d:
यस्य संधारणात्सद्यः सर्वे नश्यन्त्युपद्रवाः ।
भूतप्रेतारिजं दुःखं नाशमेति न संशयः ॥
1.78.m:
by the bearing of which all calamities instantly perish,
and sorrow born of bhūtas, pretas, and enemies comes to ruin, without a doubt.

1.78.s:
ekadāhaṃ gato draṣṭuṃ rāmaṃ ramayatāṃ varam /
ānandavanikāsaṃsthaṃ dhyāyantaṃ svātmanaḥ padam //
1.78.d:
एकदाहं गतो द्रष्टुं रामं रमयतां वरम् ।
आनन्दवनिकासंस्थं ध्यायन्तं स्वात्मनः पदम् ॥
1.78.m:
Once I went to see Rāma, the best of those who give delight,
residing in the grove of bliss, meditating on the abode of his own Self.

1.78.s:
tatra rāmaṃ ramānāthaṃ pūjitaṃ tridaśeśvaraiḥ /
namaskṛtya tadādiṣṭamāsanaṃ sthitavān puraḥ //
1.78.d:
तत्र रामं रमानाथं पूजितं त्रिदशेश्वरैः ।
नमस्कृत्य तदादिष्टमासनं स्थितवान् पुरः ॥
1.78.m:
There, having bowed to Rāma, the lord of Ramā, worshipped by the lords of the gods,
I sat down in front on the seat indicated by him.

1.78.s:
tatra sarvaṃ mayā vṛttaṃ rāvaṇasya vadhāntakam /
pṛṣṭaṃ provāca rājendraḥ śrīrāmaḥ svayamādarāt //
1.78.d:
तत्र सर्वं मया वृत्तं रावणस्य वधान्तकम् ।
पृष्टं प्रोवाच राजेन्द्रः श्रीरामः स्वयमादरात् ॥
1.78.m:
There, when I asked about the entire story culminating in the slaying of Rāvaṇa,
the royal sage, glorious Rāma himself, spoke with respect.

1.78.s:
tataḥ kathānte bhagavānmāruteḥ kavacaṃ dadau /
mahyaṃ tatte pravakṣyāmi na prakāśyaṃ hi kutracit //
1.78.d:
ततः कथान्ते भगवान्मारुतेः कवचं ददौ ।
मह्यं तत्ते प्रवक्ष्यामि न प्रकाश्यं हि कुत्रचित् ॥
1.78.m:
Then, at the end of the narrative, the Blessed Lord gave me the armor of Māruti;
I shall tell it to you, for it must not be revealed anywhere [unworthy].

1.78.s:
bhaviṣyadetannirddiṣṭaṃ bālabhāvena nārada /
śrīrāmeṇāñjanāsūnāsūnorbhuktimuktipradāyakam //
1.78.d:
भविष्यदेतन्निर्द्दिष्टं बालभावेन नारद ।
श्रीरामेणाञ्जनासूनासूनोर्भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायकम् ॥
1.78.m:
O Nārada, this [armour] of Añjanā’s son, which bestows worldly enjoyment and liberation,
was pointed out by Śrī Rāma in a future [time] out of childlike affection.

1.78.s:
hanumān pūrvataḥ pātu dakṣiṇe pavanātmajaḥ /
pātu pratīcyāmakṣaghnaḥ saumye sāgaratārakaḥ //
1.78.d:
हनुमान् पूर्वतः पातु दक्षिणे पवनात्मजः ।
पातु प्रतीच्यामक्षघ्नः सौम्ये सागरतारकः ॥
1.78.m:
May Hanumān protect me in the east, and the son of Pavana in the south;
may the slayer of Akṣa protect me in the west, and the crosser of the ocean in the north.

1.78.s:
ūrddha pātu kapiśreṣṭhaḥ kesaripriyanandanaḥ /
adhastādviṣṇubhaktastu pātu madhye ca pāvaniḥ //
1.78.d:
ऊर्द्ध पातु कपिश्रेष्ठः केसरिप्रियनन्दनः ।
अधस्ताद्विष्णुभक्तस्तु पातु मध्ये च पावनिः ॥
1.78.m:
May the best of monkeys, Kesarin's beloved son, protect above;
and below, may the devotee of Viṣṇu protect, and in the middle, the son of Pavana.

1.78.s:
laṅkāvidāhakaḥ pātu sarvāpadbhyo nirantaram /
sugrīvasacivaḥ pātu mastakaṃ vāyunandanaḥ //
1.78.d:
लङ्काविदाहकः पातु सर्वापद्भ्यो निरन्तरम् ।
सुग्रीवसचिवः पातु मस्तकं वायुनन्दनः ॥
1.78.m:
May the burner of Laṅkā protect constantly from all calamities;
may the counsellor of Sugrīva, the son of Vāyu, protect my head.

1.78.s:
bhālaṃ pātu mahāvīro bhruvormadhye nirantaram /
netre chāyāpahārī ca pātu naḥ plavageśvaraḥ //
1.78.d:
भालं पातु महावीरो भ्रुवोर्मध्ये निरन्तरम् ।
नेत्रे छायापहारी च पातु नः प्लवगेश्वरः ॥
1.78.m:
May the great hero constantly protect my forehead between the eyebrows;
may the stealer of the shadow, the lord of monkeys, protect our eyes.

1.78.s:
kapolau karṇamūle ca pātu śrīrāmakiṅkaraḥ /
nāsāgramañjanāsūnuḥ pātu vaktraṃ harīśvaraḥ //
1.78.d:
कपोलौ कर्णमूले च पातु श्रीरामकिङ्करः ।
नासाग्रमञ्जनासूनुः पातु वक्त्रं हरीश्वरः ॥
1.78.m:
May Śrī Rāma's servant protect my cheeks and the roots of my ears;
may the son of Añjanā protect the tip of my nose, and the lord of monkeys my mouth.

1.78.s:
pātu kaṇṭhe tu daityāriḥ skandhau pātu surārijit /
bhujau pātu mahātejāḥ karau ca caraṇāyudhaḥ //
1.78.d:
पातु कण्ठे तु दैत्यारिः स्कन्धौ पातु सुरारिजित् ।
भुजौ पातु महातेजाः करौ च चरणायुधः ॥
1.78.m:
May the enemy of the Daityas protect my throat, and the conqueror of the enemies of the gods my shoulders;
may the one of great splendour protect my arms, and the one whose weapons are his feet my hands.

1.78.s:
nakhānnākhāyudhaḥ pātu kukṣau pātu kapīśvaraḥ /
vakṣo mudrāpahārī ca pātu pārśve bhujāyudhaḥ //
1.78.d:
नखान्नाखायुधः पातु कुक्षौ पातु कपीश्वरः ।
वक्षो मुद्रापहारी च पातु पार्श्वे भुजायुधः ॥
1.78.m:
May the one whose weapons are his claws protect my nails; may the lord of monkeys protect my belly;
may the stealer of the ring protect my chest, and the one whose weapons are his arms my flanks.

1.78.s:
laṅkānibhañjanaḥ pātu pṛṣṭadeśe nirantaram /
nābhiṃ śrīrāmabhaktastu kaṭiṃ pātvanilātmajaḥ //
1.78.d:
लङ्कानिभञ्जनः पातु पृष्टदेशे निरन्तरम् ।
नाभिं श्रीरामभक्तस्तु कटिं पात्वनिलात्मजः ॥
1.78.m:
May the crusher of Laṅkā constantly protect my back;
may the devotee of Śrī Rāma protect my navel, and the son of Anila my waist.

1.78.s:
guhyaṃ pātu mahāprajñaḥ sakthinī atithipriyaḥ /
ūrū ca jānunī pātu laṅkāprāsādabhañjanaḥ //
1.78.d:
गुह्यं पातु महाप्रज्ञः सक्थिनी अतिथिप्रियः ।
ऊरू च जानुनी पातु लङ्काप्रासादभञ्जनः ॥
1.78.m:
May the highly wise one protect my private parts, and the lover of guests my thighs;
may the breaker of the palaces of Laṅkā protect my thighs and knees.

1.78.s:
jaṅghe pātu kapiśreṣṭho gulphau pātu mahābalaḥ /
acaloddhārakaḥ pātu pādau bhāskarasannibhaḥ //
1.78.d:
जङ्घे पातु कपिश्रेष्ठो गुल्फौ पातु महाबलः ।
अचलोद्धारकः पातु पादौ भास्करसन्निभः ॥
1.78.m:
May the best of monkeys protect my shanks, and the one of great might my ankles;
may the lifter of the mountain, who resembles the sun, protect my feet.

1.78.s:
aṅgāni pātu sattvāḍhyaḥ pātu pādāṅgulīḥ sadā /
mukhāṅgāni mahāśūraḥ pātu romāṇi cātmavān //
1.78.d:
अङ्गानि पातु सत्त्वाढ्यः पातु पादाङ्गुलीः सदा ।
मुखाङ्गानि महाशूरः पातु रोमाणि चात्मवान् ॥
1.78.m:
May the one abounding in strength protect my limbs, and always protect my toes;
may the great hero protect the parts of my face, and the self-possessed one my body hairs.

1.78.s:
divārātrau trilokeṣu sadāgatiluto 'vatu /
sthitaṃ vrajantamāsīnaṃ pibantaṃ jakṣataṃ kapiḥ //
1.78.d:
दिवारात्रौ त्रिलोकेषु सदागतिलुतो ऽवतु ।
स्थितं व्रजन्तमासीनं पिबन्तं जक्षतं कपिः ॥
1.78.m:
May the one who moves everywhere protect me day and night in the three worlds,
whether standing, walking, sitting, drinking, or eating.

1.78.s:
lokottaraguṇaḥ śrīmān pātu tryaṃbakasaṃbhavaḥ /
pramattamapramattaṃ vā śayānaṃ gahaneṃ'buni //
1.78.d:
लोकोत्तरगुणः श्रीमान् पातु त्र्यंबकसंभवः ।
प्रमत्तमप्रमत्तं वा शयानं गहनेंऽबुनि ॥
1.78.m:
May the glorious one of transcendent virtues, born of Tryambaka, protect me
whether intoxicated or heedful, sleeping, or in dense thickets or water.

1.78.s:
sthaleṃ'tarikṣe hyagnau vā parvate sāgare drume /
saṃgrāme saṃkaṭe ghore virāṅrūpadharo 'vatu //
1.78.d:
स्थलेंऽतरिक्षे ह्यग्नौ वा पर्वते सागरे द्रुमे ।
संग्रामे संकटे घोरे विराङ्रूपधरो ऽवतु ॥
1.78.m:
May the one bearing the cosmic form protect me on land, in the sky, or in fire,
on a mountain, in the ocean, in a tree, in battle, or in terrible danger.

1.78.s:
ḍākinīśākinīmārīkālarātrimarīcikāḥ /
śayānaṃ māṃ vibhuḥ pātu piśācoragarākṣasīḥ //
1.78.d:
डाकिनीशाकिनीमारीकालरात्रिमरीचिकाः ।
शयानं मां विभुः पातु पिशाचोरगराक्षसीः ॥
1.78.m:
From ḍākinīs, śākinīs, pestilences, kālarātris, mirages,
piśācas, serpents, and rākṣasīs, may the omnipresent lord protect me as I sleep.

1.78.s:
divyadehadharo dhīmānsarvasattvabhayaṅkaraḥ /
sādhakendrāvanaḥ śaśvatpātu sarvata eva mām //
1.78.d:
दिव्यदेहधरो धीमान्सर्वसत्त्वभयङ्करः ।
साधकेन्द्रावनः शश्वत्पातु सर्वत एव माम् ॥
1.78.m:
Bearing a celestial body, wise, terrifying to all beings,
protecting the best of practitioners, may he constantly protect me on every side.

1.78.s:
yadrūpaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā palāyante bhayānakāḥ /
sa sarvarūpaḥ sarvajñaḥ sṛṣṭisthitikaro 'vatu //
1.78.d:
यद्रूपं भीषणं दृष्ट्वा पलायन्ते भयानकाः ।
स सर्वरूपः सर्वज्ञः सृष्टिस्थितिकरो ऽवतु ॥
1.78.m:
Seeing whose terrible form terrifying creatures flee,
may he who has all forms, all-knowing, the maker of creation and sustenance, protect [me].

1.78.s:
svayaṃ brahmā svayaṃ viṣṇuḥ sākṣāddevo maheśvaraḥ /
sūryamaṇḍalagaḥ śrīdaḥ pātu kālatraye 'pi mām //
1.78.d:
स्वयं ब्रह्मा स्वयं विष्णुः साक्षाद्देवो महेश्वरः ।
सूर्यमण्डलगः श्रीदः पातु कालत्रये ऽपि माम् ॥
1.78.m:
Himself Brahmā, himself Viṣṇu, directly the god Maheśvara,
abiding in the solar disc, giver of prosperity, may he protect me at all three times.

1.78.s:
yasya śabdamupākarṇya daityadānavarākṣasāḥ /
devā manuṣyāstiryañcaḥ sthāvarā jaṅgamāstathā //
1.78.d:
यस्य शब्दमुपाकर्ण्य दैत्यदानवराक्षसाः ।
देवा मनुष्यास्तिर्यञ्चः स्थावरा जङ्गमास्तथा ॥
1.78.m:
Hearing whose sound, Daityas, Dānavas, Rākṣasas,
gods, humans, animals, stationary and moving beings likewise,

1.78.s:
sabhayā bhayanirmuktā bhavanti svakṛtānugāḥ /
yasyānekakathāḥ puṇyāḥ śrūyante pratikalpake //
1.78.d:
सभया भयनिर्मुक्ता भवन्ति स्वकृतानुगाः ।
यस्यानेककथाः पुण्याः श्रूयन्ते प्रतिकल्पके ॥
1.78.m:
terrified yet freed from fear, become followers of their own deeds;
whose many sacred stories are heard in every kalpa,

1.78.s:
so 'vatātsādhakaśreṣṭhaṃ sadā rāmaparāyaṇamaḥ /
vaidhātradhātṛprabhṛti yatkiñciddṛśyate 'tyalam //
1.78.d:
सो ऽवतात्साधकश्रेष्ठं सदा रामपरायणमः ।
वैधात्रधातृप्रभृति यत्किञ्चिद्दृश्यते ऽत्यलम् ॥
1.78.m:
may he protect the best practitioner who is ever devoted to Rāma.
Whatever is seen in extreme abundance, beginning with Brahmā the creator,

1.78.s:
viddhvi vyāptaṃ yathā kīśarūpeṇānañjanena tat /
yo vibhuḥ so 'hameṣo 'haṃ svīyaḥ svayamaṇurbṛhat //
1.78.d:
विद्ध्वि व्याप्तं यथा कीशरूपेणानञ्जनेन तत् ।
यो विभुः सो ऽहमेषो ऽहं स्वीयः स्वयमणुर्बृहत् ॥
1.78.m:
know that it is pervaded by him in monkey form, without stain;
he who is the Lord is I, this am I, his own, himself atomic and vast.

1.78.s:
ṛgyajuḥsāmarūpaśca praṇavastrivṛdadhvaraḥ /
tasmai svasmai ca sarvasmai nato 'smyātmasamādhinā //
1.78.d:
ऋग्यजुःसामरूपश्च प्रणवस्त्रिवृदध्वरः ।
तस्मै स्वस्मै च सर्वस्मै नतो ऽस्म्यात्मसमाधिना ॥
1.78.m:
Embodied as the Ṛg, Yajus, and Sāman, the Praṇava, the threefold sacrifice—
to him, to his own self, and to all, I bow with meditation on the Self.

1.78.s:
anekānantabrahmāṇḍadhṛte brahmasvarūpiṇe /
samīraṇātmane tasmai nato 'smyātmasvarūpiṇe //
1.78.d:
अनेकानन्तब्रह्माण्डधृते ब्रह्मस्वरूपिणे ।
समीरणात्मने तस्मै नतो ऽस्म्यात्मस्वरूपिणे ॥
1.78.m:
To the supporter of manifold infinite universes, whose nature is Brahman,
to him whose nature is the wind, whose nature is the Self, I bow.

1.78.s:
namo hanumate tasmai namo mārutasūnave /
namaḥ śrīrāmabhaktāya śyāmāya mahate namaḥ //
1.78.d:
नमो हनुमते तस्मै नमो मारुतसूनवे ।
नमः श्रीरामभक्ताय श्यामाय महते नमः ॥
1.78.m:
Obeisance to that Hanumān; obeisance to the son of Māruta;
obeisance to the devotee of Śrī Rāma, to the dark one, to the great one, obeisance!

1.78.s:
namo vānara vīrāya sugrīvasakhyakāriṇe /
saṃkāvidahanāyātha mahāsāgaratāriṇe //
1.78.d:
नमो वानर वीराय सुग्रीवसख्यकारिणे ।
संकाविदहनायाथ महासागरतारिणे ॥
1.78.m:
Obeisance to the heroic monkey who brought about friendship with Sugrīva,
to the burner of Laṅkā, and the crosser of the great ocean!

1.78.s:
sītāśokavināśāya rāmamudrādharāya ca /
rāvaṇāntanidānāya namaḥ sarvottarātmane //
1.78.d:
सीताशोकविनाशाय राममुद्राधराय च ।
रावणान्तनिदानाय नमः सर्वोत्तरात्मने ॥
1.78.m:
To the destroyer of Sītā's sorrow, the bearer of Rāma's ring,
the cause of Rāvaṇa's end, obeisance to the supreme Self of all!

1.78.s:
meghanādamakhadhvaṃsakāraṇāya namonamaḥ /
aśokavanavidhvaṃsakāriṇe jayadāyine //
1.78.d:
मेघनादमखध्वंसकारणाय नमोनमः ।
अशोकवनविध्वंसकारिणे जयदायिने ॥
1.78.m:
To the cause of the destruction of Meghanāda's sacrifice, obeisance, obeisance!
To the destroyer of the Aśoka grove, the granter of victory!

1.78.s:
vāyuputrāya vīrāya ākāśodaragāmine /
vanapālaśiraśchetre laṅkāprāsādabhañjine //
1.78.d:
वायुपुत्राय वीराय आकाशोदरगामिने ।
वनपालशिरश्छेत्रे लङ्काप्रासादभञ्जिने ॥
1.78.m:
To the son of Vāyu, the hero, who traverses the belly of the sky,
the severer of the grove-guardians' heads, the breaker of the palaces of Laṅkā!

1.78.s:
jvalatkāñcanavarṇāya dīrghalāṅgūladhāriṇe /
saumitrijayadātre ca rāmadūtāya te namaḥ //
1.78.d:
ज्वलत्काञ्चनवर्णाय दीर्घलाङ्गूलधारिणे ।
सौमित्रिजयदात्रे च रामदूताय ते नमः ॥
1.78.m:
To the one of the colour of blazing gold, bearer of a long tail,
the giver of victory to Saumitri, the messenger of Rāma, obeisance to you!

1.78.s:
akṣasya vadhakartre ca brahmaśastranivāriṇe /
lakṣmaṇāṅgamahāśaktijātakṣatavināśine //
1.78.d:
अक्षस्य वधकर्त्रे च ब्रह्मशस्त्रनिवारिणे ।
लक्ष्मणाङ्गमहाशक्तिजातक्षतविनाशिने ॥
1.78.m:
To the slayer of Akṣa, the averter of the weapon of Brahmā,
the healer of the wound born from the great lance on Lakṣmaṇa’s body!

1.78.s:
rakṣoghnāya ripughnāya bhūtaghnāya namonamaḥ /
ṛkṣavānaravīraughaprāsādāya namonamaḥ //
1.78.d:
रक्षोघ्नाय रिपुघ्नाय भूतघ्नाय नमोनमः ।
ऋक्षवानरवीरौघप्रासादाय नमोनमः ॥
1.78.m:
To the slayer of Rākṣasas, the slayer of foes, the slayer of spirits, obeisance, obeisance!
To the palace of the hosts of bear and monkey heroes, obeisance, obeisance!

1.78.s:
parasainyabalaghnāya śastrāstraghnāya te namaḥ /
viṣaghnāya dviṣaghnāya bhayaghnāya namonamaḥ //
1.78.d:
परसैन्यबलघ्नाय शस्त्रास्त्रघ्नाय ते नमः ।
विषघ्नाय द्विषघ्नाय भयघ्नाय नमोनमः ॥
1.78.m:
To the destroyer of the strength of enemy armies, destroyer of weapons and missiles, obeisance to you!
To the destroyer of poison, destroyer of adversaries, destroyer of fear, obeisance, obeisance!

1.78.s:
mahīripubhayaghnāya bhaktatrāṇaikakāriṇa /
parapreritamantrāṇāṃ mantrāṇāṃ staṃbhakāriṇe //
1.78.d:
महीरिपुभयघ्नाय भक्तत्राणैककारिण ।
परप्रेरितमन्त्राणां मन्त्राणां स्तंभकारिणे ॥
1.78.m:
To the destroyer of the fear of earthly enemies, whose sole act is protecting devotees,
the paralyser of hostile mantras sent by others!

1.78.s:
payaḥ pāṣāṇataraṇakāraṇāya namonamaḥ /
bālārkamaṇḍalagrāsakāriṇe duḥkhahāriṇe //
1.78.d:
पयः पाषाणतरणकारणाय नमोनमः ।
बालार्कमण्डलग्रासकारिणे दुःखहारिणे ॥
1.78.m:
To the cause of stones floating on the water, obeisance, obeisance!
To the swallower of the disc of the morning sun, the remover of grief!

1.78.s:
nakhāyudhāya bhīmāya dantāyudhadharāya ca /
vihṝṅgamāya śavāya vajradehāya te namaḥ //
1.78.d:
नखायुधाय भीमाय दन्तायुधधराय च ।
विहॄङ्गमाय शवाय वज्रदेहाय ते नमः ॥
1.78.m:
To the one whose weapons are his claws, the formidable one, bearer of teeth as weapons,
the roamer in the sky, the auspicious one, the one with an adamantine body, obeisance to you!

1.78.s:
pratigrāmasthitāyātha bhūtapretavadhārthine /
karasthaśailaśastrāya rāma śastrāya te namaḥ //
1.78.d:
प्रतिग्रामस्थितायाथ भूतप्रेतवधार्थिने ।
करस्थशैलशस्त्राय राम शस्त्राय ते नमः ॥
1.78.m:
To the one residing in every village, seeking the destruction of bhūtas and pretas,
whose weapon is a mountain held in his hand, the weapon of Rāma, obeisance to you!

1.78.s:
kaupīnavāsase tubhyaṃ rāmabhaktiratāya ca /
dakṣiṇāśābhāskarāya satāṃ candrodayātmane //
1.78.d:
कौपीनवाससे तुभ्यं रामभक्तिरताय च ।
दक्षिणाशाभास्कराय सतां चन्द्रोदयात्मने ॥
1.78.m:
To you dressed in a loincloth, delighting in devotion to Rāma,
the sun of the southern quarter, the embodiment of moonrise for the virtuous!

1.78.s:
kṛtyākṣatavyathāghnāya sarvakleśaharāya ca /
svāmyājñāpārthasaṃgrāmasakhyasaṃjayakāriṇe //
1.78.d:
कृत्याक्षतव्यथाघ्नाय सर्वक्लेशहराय च ।
स्वाम्याज्ञापार्थसंग्रामसख्यसंजयकारिणे ॥
1.78.m:
To the destroyer of the affliction of wounds caused by sorcery, the remover of all distress,
the bringer of complete victory through alliance in battle on behalf of Arjuna by his master’s command!

1.78.s:
bhaktānāṃ divyavādeṣu saṃgrāme jayakāriṇe /
kilkilāvuvakārāya ghoraśabdakarāya ca //
1.78.d:
भक्तानां दिव्यवादेषु संग्रामे जयकारिणे ।
किल्किलावुवकाराय घोरशब्दकराय च ॥
1.78.m:
To the bringer of victory to devotees in divine debates and in battle,
the maker of sounds of roaring and shouts, producer of terrible noises!

1.78.s:
sarvāgnivyādhisaṃstaṃbhakāriṇe bhayahāriṇe /
sadā vanaphalāhārasaṃtṛptāya viśeṣataḥ //
1.78.d:
सर्वाग्निव्याधिसंस्तंभकारिणे भयहारिणे ।
सदा वनफलाहारसंतृप्ताय विशेषतः ॥
1.78.m:
To the paralyser of all fires and diseases, the remover of fear,
especially satisfied always by food of wild fruits!

1.78.s:
mahārṇavaśilābaddhvasetubandhāya te namaḥ /
ityetatkathitaṃ vipra māruteḥ kavacaṃ śivam //
1.78.d:
महार्णवशिलाबद्ध्वसेतुबन्धाय ते नमः ।
इत्येतत्कथितं विप्र मारुतेः कवचं शिवम् ॥
1.78.m:
To the builder of the bridge constructed with stones across the great ocean, obeisance to you!
Thus has been spoken, O brahmin, the auspicious armour of Māruta's son.

1.78.s:
yasmai kasmai na dātavyaṃ rakṣaṇīyaṃ prayatnataḥ /
aṣṭagandhairvilikhyātha kavacaṃ dhārayettu yaḥ //
1.78.d:
यस्मै कस्मै न दातव्यं रक्षणीयं प्रयत्नतः ।
अष्टगन्धैर्विलिख्याथ कवचं धारयेत्तु यः ॥
1.78.m:
It must not be given to just anyone; it should be preserved with great care.
If one writes this armour with the eight perfumes and wears it

1.78.s:
kaṇṭhe vā dakṣiṇe bāhau jayastasya pade pade /
kiṃ punarbahunoktena sādhitaṃ lakṣamādarāt //
1.78.d:
कण्ठे वा दक्षिणे बाहौ जयस्तस्य पदे पदे ।
किं पुनर्बहुनोक्तेन साधितं लक्षमादरात् ॥
1.78.m:
either on the neck or on the right arm, victory belongs to him at every step.
What need is there of much speaking? When accomplished with care by one hundred thousand [repetitions],

1.78.s:
prajaptametatkavacamasādhyaṃ cāpi sādhayet //
iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne tṛtīyapāde hanumatkavacanirūpaṇaṃ nāmāṣṭasaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
1.78.d:
प्रजप्तमेतत्कवचमसाध्यं चापि साधयेत् ॥
इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने तृतीयपादे हनुमत्कवचनिरूपणं नामाष्टसप्ततितमो ऽध्यायः
1.78.m:
reciting this armour will accomplish even the impossible.

Thus ends the seventy-eighth chapter, titled 'Exposition of the Hanumat-kavaca', in the third quarter of the great narrative in the first section of the glorious Bṛhannāradīya Purāṇa.
